# Workflows auto-tag.yml must start when a v* tag is created and no PAT is
# available to make the tag push trigger them (#116). One entry per line:
#
#   <workflow-file>
#   <workflow-file>|<extra `gh workflow run` arguments>
#
# The set must equal the workflows whose `on.push` fires for a release tag,
# and every entry must declare `workflow_dispatch:`. That equality is
# enforced *before* the tag is created by
# .github/scripts/check-release-fanout.py; the dispatch step reads this file so
# the manifest is the single source of truth.
#
# `@TAG@` in the extra-argument column is replaced with the release tag.
# release-versions.yml takes a required `tag` input because a run may be
# dispatched for a past release.
#
# python-sdk-release.yml is absent on purpose: it triggers on `python-sdk/v*`,
# not on a release tag.
publish-self-hosted-images.yml
build-publish.yml
cli.yml
publish-workspace-image.yml
server-sdk.yml
release-versions.yml|--field tag=@TAG@
docs.yml
connector-release.yml
ios-release.yml
mac-release.yml
